changes: Inventory CSV import now asks for an import mode before applying rows.
Replace Inventory mode sets matching existing rows to the CSV count and sets editable rows not present in the CSV to 0.
Add To Current mode adds each CSV count to the currently shown New Count for matching existing rows.
Import still queues unsaved changes only; Save Changes or Save Changes As is required to write the save.
Import report now includes rows zeroed during replace mode.
safety: Still only patches existing inventory rows.
Brand-new item row insertion remains disabled.
